NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BAMA uses your photo library so you can choose photos and videos for your profile, portfolio, chats and marketplace listings.
NSCameraUsageDescription: BAMA uses the camera so you can take a photo and send it in a chat.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BAMA uses the microphone to record voice messages in chats.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: BAMA adds project meetings to your calendar when you ask it to.
